title: Access-token UI, version defaults, roles, and registration limits on an SCA 2026.7.0 sandbox

environment.label: isolated SCA sandbox
environment.access: Claude desktop built-in browser session signed in by the owner

principal.note: Findings reflect what a system administrator sees. Other roles may see different menus or pages.

method.actions: Opened menus and pages; opened Create Token, Create Standard Project, and Create Version forms only to read them and cancelled each; API GET requests through the signed-in page. The registration key was not read or recorded.
method.mutation_check: Before and after: the administrator's token count stayed 4, the sampled project's version count stayed 2, and the project count stayed 5.

findings.statement: The top-right user menu button shows the signed-in user's display name ("System" for the system administrator), not a fixed label. Its items are Profile, Global Roles, User Groups, Watched Projects, Access Tokens, SCM Providers, and Log Out.

documentation.note: "System > Access Tokens" matches only when the signed-in user's display name is System; other users see their own name, and a reader can mistake it for the Admin area.

findings.statement: User menu > Access Tokens opens My Settings > Access Tokens, which has a Create Token button (plus icon). The Create Token dialog has Name, Description, and Scope with Read Access Only or Read and Write Access, and no scope is preselected.

documentation.note: The route is correct; the page says My Access Tokens and Create New Token.

findings.statement: Admin > Access Tokens opens Administration > Access Tokens, which lists all users' tokens with a Delete action and has no create action.
Both Create Standard Project and an existing project's Create Version default to Phase In Planning, Distribution External, and Approval Status Unreviewed.

documentation.note: Approval Status default is not covered by any case.

findings.statement: GET /api/roles describes Global Project Administrator as able to create, modify, and delete projects and versions; Global Project Manager as having administration and management privileges to all projects, including editing all BOMs (creation not stated); and Project Creator as able to create projects and assume the Project Manager role for them. Effective permissions were not tested.

Admin > System Settings > Product Registration shows the registration's limits, license features, and licensed modules. This sandbox's registration lists unlimited codebase size and a maximum of 21.00 GB scan size per scan; these values belong to this registration, not to customers generally.

documentation.note: The page says the code size limit is declared in your license.

findings.statement: Product Registration lists the Snippets module as Licensed on this sandbox.

open_gaps: Test effective project-creation permissions with users holding Global Project Manager and Project Creator only.
Record which roles can confirm or ignore unconfirmed snippets, using a role test user and a disposable snippet match.
Record the minimum roles for a Detect scan that maps to a new version, using a role test user.
Check whether a project and version created by a Detect scan, without --detect.project.version.phase or --detect.project.version.distribution, get the UI defaults (In Planning, External).
